name: BRHT — Fable Fury PostgreSQL historical backfill — API DEPLOYED

parameters.query:
SELECT date::text AS date,
       lower(trim(channel)) AS channel,
       COALESCE(orders, 0)::numeric AS orders,
       COALESCE(revenue, 0)::numeric AS revenue,
       COALESCE(spend, 0)::numeric AS spend,
       COALESCE(conversions, 0)::numeric AS conversions,
       updated_at
FROM daily_channel_metrics

ORDER BY date ASC, channel ASC;

nodes.name: Read channel metrics
nodes.notes: Select the existing n8n PostgreSQL credential named “Postgres account”.

parameters.query:
SELECT date::text AS date,
       product_id::text AS product_id,
       product_name,
       COALESCE(units_sold, 0)::numeric AS units_sold,
       updated_at
FROM shopify_product_daily

ORDER BY date ASC, product_id::text ASC;

nodes.name: Read product daily
nodes.notes: Select the existing n8n PostgreSQL credential named “Postgres account”.

parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id::text)
       product_id::text AS product_id,
       product_name,
       available_quantity,
       snapshot_at
FROM inventory_snapshots
ORDER BY product_id::text, snapshot_at DESC;
